Goal.description: The named beneficiary outcome and exclusions are understandable to the sponsor; achievement requires observed benefit against success_predicate, not completion of tasks.

Mission.description: Goal alignment and the continuing purpose are owned; retirement inventories surviving commitments and names accepted custodians.

Project.description: The declared deliverables satisfy the stage and acceptance contract; missing or disputed deliverables remain pending and closure carries every duty.

Workstream.description: An accepted mandate, recurring capacity and continuity route support the ongoing purpose; a pause preserves already due occurrences.

WorkDependency.description: The exact target supplies the source prerequisite with matching meaning, unit and time; inapplicability requires a competent scoped decision, not scheduling preference.

Blocker.description: The named resolution predicate is met by new evidence or an authorized limit decision; accepted_limit never substitutes for a missing safety or legal prerequisite.

WorkflowDefinition.description: All ports and step IDs resolve, dependency graph is acyclic, every exit/skip/retry is bounded, and producer/evaluator separation survives composition.

WorkflowRun.description: Every required step has an accepted output or specifically lawful skip, actual deliverables are present, and unfinished duties are accounted for.

StepExecution.description: The actual attempt output matches the exact step exit predicate; reporting is not acceptance and provider exit code is not a beneficiary outcome.

AgentTemplate.description: Trials show usable output on fixed, fresh and adverse cases at the declared runtime and bounds; tool authority is inherited separately.

AgentInstance.description: The exact admitted work lease, identity, runtime and context are current; stop or expiry checkpoints all unfinished duties without silently retrying.

ExecutionSelection.description: Eligibility precedes ranking; compare feasible deterministic, human, native and service routes and bound selection effort; unknown capacity is not available capacity.

ReasoningPlan.description: A next discriminating observation distinguishes named hypotheses within the existing causal allowance; an inconclusive stopping point retains uncertainty.

Delegation.description: Recipient has acknowledged exact scope then separately accepted work with competence, access, reservations and deadlines; depth and causal cost never reset.

WorkMessage.description: Sender and recipient are authenticated for this purpose; delivery is a recorded receipt, not understanding, assignment acceptance or completed work.

MessageAcknowledgment.description: The actual recipient supplies this acknowledgment for the exact message; acceptance of assignment additionally joins the transfer contract.

WorkspaceAssignment.description: Base revision, path ownership and shared-resource leases are current; overlapping writable paths require an explicit serialized integration work order.

FailureRecord.description: A retry has new discriminating evidence or a genuinely changed condition and remaining causal allowance; unknown external effects are reconciled first.

Schedule.description: The versioned calendar resolves ambiguity, missed occurrences and concurrency before activation; accepted alternates and due-duty resources are real.

ScheduleOccurrence.description: Unique schedule/version/local occurrence key; actual wake is recorded; missed windows receive their declared individual or coalesced duty disposition.

InstructionBundle.description: Instructions preserve company authority boundaries, typed outputs and tested runtime behavior; examples and inherited rules have source provenance.

SkillVersion.description: Exact files, compatible ports, provenance and usable license are present; tests include failure cases and composition under the proposed native runtime.

SkillSelection.description: Applicable skills are current and compatible; no_match and budget_exhausted are honest results, with bounded fallback rather than endless selection.

SourceRecord.description: Original bytes, issuer, version, dates, incentives and capture omissions remain attributable; source existence alone does not make claims true.

KnowledgeQuestion.description: The explicit resolution predicate is answered by attributable claims or closed as inconclusive with search coverage; absence of evidence is not a positive answer.

ContextTransformation.description: Source spans and omitted qualifiers are preserved according to the exact preservation contract; loss must be tested for the declared downstream purpose.

SummaryLoss.description: The identified omission has an explicit affected decision/purpose and actual repair evidence or a continuing unresolved restriction.

RetrievalAttempt.description: Permission filtering precedes ranking and disclosure; selected spans reproduce exact sources, coverage/omissions and bounded scan cost are recorded.

RetrievalProfile.description: Lexical parser/ranking/tie-break rules are deterministic and tested; protected storage uses bounded ephemeral scanning, never unauthorized persistent indexing.

ContradictionSet.description: Scope, time, units and opposing source incentives are compared; settled means the named discriminator resolved the conflict, not majority agreement.

ForgetRequest.description: The requested operation is distinguished from erasure; current restrictions and every known late/offline derivative carry continuing deletion scope.

AccountReconstruction.description: The account at the specified frontier can be reconstructed from protected sources with omissions; replay and live rerun are labeled separately.

EvaluationPlan.description: Requirements, outcome/process criteria, comparator rights, resource matching, sampling, stochastic trials, stop rules and independent evaluator are fixed before results.

EvaluationRun.description: All selected cases and attempted trials, including failures and nonruns, enter the denominator; completeness is separate from a passing outcome.

CasePool.description: Selection provenance, protected withheld membership and bridge cases establish what population is represented; changing cases does not erase the old baseline.

EvaluationCase.description: Expected outcome/process and label provenance are adjudicated independently; synthetic fixtures are labeled and cannot establish actual market benefit.

EvaluationTrial.description: Actual inputs, reset evidence, runtime, all observations, omissions and cost are recorded for this selected case, including stochastic trial identity.

EvaluatorProfile.description: Competence is bounded to the evaluated domain, calibration includes false accepts/rejects and drift; shared unknown roots are disclosed.

Review.description: The named independent reviewer actually inspected the listed material; findings, omissions and time are retained and report completion is not subject acceptance.

IndexSnapshot.description: Exact source watermark, permission class and completeness are verified; protected ephemeral generation is destroyed on expiry and never promoted to persistent storage.

Venture.description: Purpose, sponsor, current stage and shared dependencies are explicit; stage change does not fabricate readiness, receipts or closure of surviving duties.

Opportunity.description: Observed problem and alternative support the next bounded discriminator; advancement does not imply proven demand.

ResearchPlan.description: Population, sampling and disconfirming cases are explicit; source access and any participant contact are authorized for the actual disclosure.

ObservationSet.description: Original observations and actual sample membership/withdrawals are preserved; missing cohorts and nonresponse remain in the analysis.

MarketBrief.description: Competitor and market claims retain dated sources, conflicting observations and unresolved boundaries; decision usefulness is assessed without invented precision.

ProductSpec.description: Requirements and journey checks describe a usable beneficiary outcome, explicit exclusions and actual dependency predicates.

ExperienceArtifact.description: The prototype can complete the specified journey; accessibility evaluation runs and actual user observations are distinguished from owner taste decisions.

BrandGuide.description: Identity and voice follow endorsed intent; actual asset rights and claim support are checked, with owner taste reserved to its mandate.

BuildArtifact.description: The exact source/build artifacts meet the product tests and maintenance procedure; release requires an actual reconciled deployment operation.

Offer.description: The seller can honor these exact terms using verified delivery/support capacity; authority to publish and charge is separate from internal readiness.

LaunchReadiness.description: Every unique predeclared launch requirement maps to its exact distinct subject and current accepted predicate judgment; actual delivery/support continuity exists.

ContentAsset.description: Published claims and asset rights are supported for the intended audience and disclosure; approval does not itself publish the asset.

Campaign.description: Recipients, contact allocation, offer and content are current; measurement/stop rules and actual consent/suppression constraints bind each send.

SalesAgreement.description: Actual buyer acceptance of exact terms is captured; performance is shown by substantive fulfillment and disputes retain enforceable duties.

Conversation.description: Original messages and exact parties, promises and restrictions are preserved; model summaries never replace the exchange.

SupportCase.description: The actual problem is resolved or a reasoned disposition with accessible grievance route is delivered; a drafted reply is not a remedy.

PriceProposal.description: Internal provisional pricing may preserve unknown demand; bounded tests require real capacity/grant; commercial demand-supported and scale claims require actual demand evidence.

Economics.description: Observed, estimated and unknown amounts stay distinct; owner/maintenance/external burden and closure obligations enter the same period with stated allocation limits.

CashPosition.description: Native account statements reconcile through an exact frontier; outstanding and unknown holds are retained, and coverage gaps do not become spendable cash.

JournalBatch.description: Entries balance by currency/exponent, match source documents and authoritative accounting treatment, and identify unreconciled items without inventing receipts.

ProfessionalRequest.description: A competent actual provider accepts the scoped deliverable, deadline and funded engagement; a prepared request does not count as a determination.

ProfessionalDetermination.description: The actual named competent issuer supplies an applicable conclusion for this activity/jurisdiction nexus; unknown law and expired scope remain unresolved.

ProcessingUse.description: The actual data subjects, purposes, recipients, determination and rights route cover every disclosed field and downstream copy.

SecurityCase.description: Containment tests show what authority/data path was actually removed; unknown residual paths and due communications remain open.

SupplierEngagement.description: Actual supplier competence, capacity, terms and payment authority support the defined deliverable; renewal and exit duties have owners.

Partnership.description: Both parties actually agree to distinct contributions, attribution and duties; shared dependency and exit liabilities have continuing ownership.

CandidateAssessment.description: Job-relevant work samples and criteria are assessed by a competent person; candidate burden and challenge access remain visible, with no IQ/profile surrogate.

MetricDefinition.description: Population, numerator, denominator, exclusions, units, transformation and interpretation ownership are unambiguous and source-reconstructable.

MetricSeries.description: Values reproduce raw evidence under the exact metric definition; missing intervals and excluded cohorts remain visible.

Experiment.description: Actual assignment and exposure follow the predeclared control/treatment and stopping rule within real reservations; unknown results stay unknown.

Fulfillment.description: The actual performer completes contracted delivery/onboarding steps in the service window; beneficiary acceptance and remaining duties are observed, not simulated.

Incident.description: Observed trigger, response authority and commander coordinate real containment/recovery and communication; resolution requires tested criteria and residual duties.

KnowledgeEntry.description: The entry preserves claim epistemic type, originals, contradictions, expiration and replacement; retrieval presence does not strengthen truth.

LearningProposal.description: Observed outcomes support a falsifiable causal hypothesis and bounded experiment; a persuasive narrative is not proof of improvement.

CapacityStudy.description: Observed demand waves and substantive fulfilled outcomes include maintenance/owner/foregone-work cost and exercised continuity; no unexecuted scale claim.

PausePlan.description: New exposure is bounded while current service, renewals and remedies retain actual capacity; resume has explicit revalidation conditions.

RecoveryPacket.description: Historical frontier evidence is labeled as evidence only; actual recovery queries a fresh nonce-bound frontier and preserves unknown effects/restrictions.

PivotPlan.description: The owner endorses the changed purpose and assumptions while old obligations retain accepted custodians and transition funding.

ClosurePlan.description: Complete duties, renewals, data copies and grievances have actual dispositions, funding and continuing custodians; residual closure is distinct from finished closure.

FormationReadiness.description: Actual principal, signatories, accounts, rights and activity-specific professional prerequisites are verified for this scope; conditional readiness permits preparation only.

TransferPlan.description: Successor independently accepts exact duties with access, competence and resources before outgoing access cutover; unmet transfers retain an explicit custodian.

ParticipationPlan.description: The actual person accepts availability and attention bounds; fixed adverse samples and unaided transfer checks do not grant software values authority.

BusinessAccount.description: Every material decision, attempt, duty and adverse result resolves at the stated frontier; omissions and causal limits are retained.

ExecutionCapacity.description: The actual provider route, auth/billing, allowances, local slots and fallback are verified for this window; subscription access promises no guaranteed availability.

ImprovementProposal.description: The precise change and protected dependencies link to independent evaluations and a bounded rollout/rollback under ProtectedChange authority.

DeliveryCapacity.description: Before any sale, actual performer acceptance/competence, materials, access, service window, reservations and jointly viable continuity are checked; no SalesAgreement is required.

Principal.description: Attributable identity and legal standing assertions distinguish a natural person from an actual entity; no software-created registration fact.

IdentityBinding.description: Authenticated issuer/subject, holder, current identity epoch and validity are verified; workload identity cannot inherit the owner login authority.

IntentVersion.description: Actual owner endorsement binds these original words, beneficiary, exclusions and purpose; model interpretation has no independent direction authority.

Mandate.description: Actual issuer standing and holder acceptance cover exact scope/commands, competence and absence rules without delegated expansion.

Case.description: Sponsor, outcome and acceptance contract admit feasible work; acceptance requires the actual outcome, and abandonment preserves every surviving obligation.

Obligation.description: Recognized duty has competent source/standing and deadlines; discharge requires actual performance or competent lawful nonarising/transfer disposition.

CausalEpisode.description: All correlated revisions, retries and delegations share one allowance and protected closure duty; renewals require explicit authority and changed conditions.

WorkOrder.description: Exact task inputs, acceptance owner, context/tool limits, lease, deadline and real reservations make substantive work executable; report receipt is separate from acceptance.

AttemptReport.description: The authenticated leased executor reports actual artifacts, usage, omissions and unfinished duties; it cannot settle its own output or external effect.

ArtifactVersion.description: Exact content bytes, loader/capture provenance, validation and inherited restrictions are complete for this destination and purpose.

Observation.description: Exact captured bytes, actual observer/source, time interval and omissions support attributed facts; parsing cannot assert beneficiary acceptance by itself.

Claim.description: Supporting and opposing evidence, scope and uncertainty justify the epistemic status; retraction and conflicts remain historical.

ReasonRecord.description: The statement is attributed as endorsed reason, executor report, hypothesis or unknown influence, without fabricated hidden reasoning.

DecisionRecord.description: The actual deciding identities have current mandates for the chosen exact option and scope; evidence, alternatives, omissions and dissent remain accessible.

ContextManifest.description: Loader captures every actual influence including tools, startup rules and native ancestry, with permission, destination, current epochs and known omissions.

ValidityEpoch.description: Restriction increments are serialized with publication/release and inherited by known and late derivatives; list propagation is not the exclusion barrier.

EvidenceBaseVersion.description: The protected transitive dependency closure includes source, parser, meaning, selector, population and evaluator roots and actual completeness frontier.

EvidenceJudgment.description: A competent independent evaluator decides the exact registered predicate on immutable subject bytes and current evidence closure; inconclusive is completed assessment without subject success.

Continuation.description: Actual witnessed checkpoint and remaining duties, operations, deadlines and resources are complete; acknowledgment alone does not transfer responsibility.

ResponsibilityAssignment.description: The actual custodian accepts this principal/scope/duties with mandate, competence, deadlines and viable continuity; naming a person is not capacity.

InteractionDetermination.description: Cross-entity, population, purpose and shared-failure consequences are investigated by a competent owner; unknown material interaction narrows dependent effects.

ResponseDecision.description: Observation, contest, inquiry, bounded containment, suspension and direction each have their own actual authority/materiality/expiry, while ordinary service and true complaints survive.

GrievanceCase.description: Noncustomers and disputed custodians have an accessible competent independent route; reasons, deadlines, actual remedy funding and continuity survive closure.

DeletionScope.description: Continuing restriction covers late derivatives, offline rejoin and physical copies; verified requires actual receipts, while lawful retention and unknown copies remain explicit residuals.

Grant.description: Actual issuer mandate, exact holder, purpose, destinations, qualitative bounds and expiry attenuate any parent; no positive authority arises from empty selectors.

ResourceAccount.description: Authorized and independently observed quantities use compatible units; consumed, reserved and uncertain amounts cannot be released by reset or bookkeeping assertion.

Reservation.description: Exact work/operation and causal episode hold the maximum possible quantity until authoritative reconciliation; expiry cannot release an unresolved effect hold.

OperationIntent.description: Exact business bytes, parameter provenance, interaction classes, grants, scope claims, current prerequisites and actual completion owner support this intended effect.

ConflictClaim.description: Exact canonical/aliased business keys serialize overlapping consequences and entitlements; unknown predecessor effects retain the hold through scope migration.

RecoveryEnvelope.description: Independent storage contains every exact byte, key, dependency, authority, restriction and potential duty needed to interpret this operation after owner/provider joint failure.

PrerequisiteSnapshot.description: Complete source/meaning/participant/epoch inputs are current at the release cutoff; later lists are not a substitute for the ordered validation.

Release.description: C04 orders exact operation and conflicts after independent envelope durability; the release is immutable authorization evidence, never a local success inference.

SendClaim.description: One-use claim binds exact request, release, gateway generation/boot, finite first-transport deadline and maximum bytes; it cannot authorize a second dispatch.

ExternalAttempt.description: Actual gateway first transport, provider response and effect observations are distinct; late first send, delayed acceptance and retry have separate contracts.

OperationStatus.description: Derived current phase/effect knowledge/stop disposition cites authoritative release/attempt/frontier; it cannot grant, prove independent durability or overwrite history.

ParameterAuthority.description: Each meaningful request field binds a current authoritative source and admitted deterministic transformation; a masked credential or model value is insufficient.

DisclosureContract.description: Actual recipient, exact material/purpose, exclusions, construction and cumulative descendant constraints authorize every disclosed input and tool stdout.

RetryContract.description: Each retry follows outcome-specific actual evidence and remaining attempts/time; unknown effects never enter a blind transient retry path.

ScopeRegistry.description: Changed aliases/conflict scopes/issuers freeze affected admission, retain all old unknown holds and invalidate obsolete unreleased preparations before ordered resumption.

RegistryMembership.description: Current primary/witness/standby/gateway identities and key/time profiles are independently admitted; prior generation is sealed/fenced before activation.

GenerationSeal.description: Independent witness seals the exact complete old-generation frontier and all issued transport windows/unknown effects; old authority is not silently reinstated.

DurabilityReceipt.description: R independently stores and signs the exact contiguous group hash and required recoverable contents; a primary row or uncertain standby acknowledgment is insufficient.

KeyManifest.description: Actually accessible independent keys and wrapping dependencies cover all recovery material without shared owner/provider failure or unrecoverable key deletion.

BackupPolicy.description: Real storage, keys and custodian access support tested restoration and destructive exercises under retention limits; a policy document is not recoverability.

AccessDescendant.description: Actual token/account/native copy and residual authority are discovered, constrained and independently checked; offline or unknown copies remain restrictions.

RuntimeProfile.description: Exact executables/configuration, isolation surfaces, auth route, resource bounds and fault domains pass actual boundary tests; no silent paid fallback.

SemanticMappingVersion.description: Every source field/state/meaning and authority target has an explicit tested mapping; unmapped authority or lossy evidence holds migration.

ProtectedChange.description: Independent trials and actual authorization precede bounded activation; new claims, monitoring failure or cumulative interaction reopen assessment.

ReleaseManifest.description: Exact source tree, artifact digests, dependency lock, schemas, meaning and installed profiles are frozen after verification; rebuilt bytes are another manifest.

RolloutPlan.description: Cohorts, exposure, stop predicates, due duties and rollback resources are bounded and actually available; missing monitoring blocks increased exposure.

ChangeWatch.description: Actual observation cadence and stop owner cover the deployed exact manifest; absent telemetry is a visibility gap, not a successful change.

MigrationPlan.description: Old/new representations and meaning are tested with loss checks, readers/writers fenced, unknown holds carried and rollback boundary explicit.

Deployment.description: Actual reconciled native version activation matches the exact manifest and exposure; command acceptance or local build cannot establish public deployment.

RollbackPlan.description: Prior software compatibility is tested without reverting grants, live epochs or business history; actual compensating operations and residual duties are reconciled.

AdapterProfile.description: Exact executable, endpoints, parser, schemas, bounds and native semantics pass adverse admission tests; credentials and owner login never imply business authority.

IntegrationConnection.description: Actual principal/account/standing/billing and destination route are verified, with usable renewal/recovery custodians and no silent provider substitution.

IntegrationInvocation.description: Exact typed arguments, parameter provenance, context and reservations are admitted; external effects use their separate C04 operation and gateway.

IntegrationObservation.description: Original captured response, source cursor and transport outcome support parsed observations; provider status and internal acceptance remain distinct.

SourceCursor.description: Continuity through the declared query interval is proven from captured pages/events; gaps survive cursor movement and require reconciliation.

BillingProfile.description: Actual auth/billing mode, current price/credit/renewal/auto-reload observations and authorized exposure are checked; documentation alone is not account configuration.

CapacityObservation.description: Actual source measurement, unit, coverage and freshness are recorded; unknown measurement holds its declared maximum and never becomes available capacity.

Suppression.description: The actual recipient/purpose/channel restriction is active before subsequent contact; only competent current authority with actual evidence can lift it.

DecisionPacket.description: Exact options/action digest, current subjects, contrary evidence, unknowns, latest responsible time and no-answer behavior are visible through the proper permission filter.

HumanResponse.description: Actual authenticated person answered the exact unexpired challenge and packet; duplicate/conflicting/late answers cannot silently authorize a changed action.

ParticipationEncounter.description: The selected original/adverse sample and actual before-advice/feedback encounter are recorded with burden; a completed prompt is not demonstrated competence transfer.

DomainAssessment.description: Assessment addresses the specific operational competence gap with evidence and assistance; disagreement does not give software personal values authority.

HandoffAcceptance.description: The actual incoming person independently accepts exact duties after access, competence and continuity checks; receipt or same-person reassignment does not remove shared failure.

InterventionRequest.description: Requested pause/cancel/contain/revoke/resume is routed to the appropriate authority; visible pending request is not proof the external effect stopped.

OperatorProjection.description: Permission-filtered sources, actual watermark, omissions and refresh latency determine freshness; no decorative activity or secret-bearing cache.

DecisionChallenge.description: One-use challenge binds exact packet, action digest, expected revisions and authenticated actor before expiry; replay preserves the original result.

Account.description: Actual native account identity, principal standing and custody are verified; a ledger label cannot create a bank account or balance.

DomainAuthorityBinding.description: One explicit native authority supplies these fields during the interval; replacement freezes writers and meaning before any new authority becomes current.

ContinuityArrangement.description: Actual accepted alternate has independent access, competence, funding and exercised ability within the duty window, including owner/provider joint failure.

Constraint.description: The actual issuer endorses this exact scope and predicate; changes require its named amendment authority and cannot be inferred from easier implementation.

Principle.description: The owner-endorsed principle has concrete hard-decision examples and a named amendment route; software may expose contradictions but cannot rewrite values.

Commitment.description: Actual authorized promise and counterparty acts create duties under exact terms; ending a label does not erase beneficiary rights or unresolved performance.

Defect.description: Actual failing predicate, scope and consequence are recorded; repair requires independent evidence against the failure, while accepted residuals need competent authority.

AccessPolicy.description: Actual reader/mandate/purpose/field and destination constraints bind current epochs; empty scope does not authorize a universal read.

RetentionPolicy.description: Field sensitivity and every physical copy class have actual purpose, deadline, determination and deletion handling, regardless of field size or primitive type.

DeletionReceipt.description: Actual observer verifies this scope/copy class/method at the stated time and preserves limits; a queued deletion is not erased material.

DependencyClosure.description: All required typed transitive edges are enumerated at a witnessed frontier with no omissions; proof/source cycles and absent roots cannot supply their own evidence.

ConfigurationVersion.description: Exact closed configuration variant, schema/meaning version and independent admission cover its use; protected changes cannot enter as plain file edits.

ConsequenceClassDefinition.description: A competent admitted classification predicate and gates cover this new consequence class without a universal risk score or invented founder tolerance.

DomainEvent.description: Immutable committed event body is indexed as revision1; delivered Position and durability proof remain response metadata outside committed bytes.

AccessGraph.description: Actual enumeration proves the declared descendant surface at the source frontier; incomplete/unknown access paths remain explicit residuals.

OperationalAdmission.description: Actual independent durability, gateway, restore, native-isolation, continuity and funding prerequisites pass at this exact runtime and membership before consequential operation.

LifecycleStatus.description: The component that owns this subject transition records the exact immutable subject, permitted edge, evidence and actor mandate; status is not another business revision.

AcceptanceInterval.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#5-delegation-messages-and-accountable-handoffs). The interval between producer-declared completion and acceptance is a named, queryable state with a holder: the producing structure's sponsor.

AdmissionRecord.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#2-intent-scopes-dependencies-and-admission). Admission computes the consequence class before the kind. Typing has three admissible outcomes -- matched, no_match and budget_exhausted -- and typing into the nearest existing kind is a recorded failure never scored as success.

ArmedSet.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#7-durable-schedules-and-capacity-gaps). Derived, not written. It is the deterministic evaluation of every admitted interest against one journal position, and no component may prevent membership.

ConsequenceDerivation.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#11-consequence-class-and-the-layer-contract). The reached class set is computed by one deterministic function from the resolved parameters, the destination and egress identity, the selector closure and the owning capability contract's declared floor, and from nothing else.

ConstraintSet.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#5-delegation-messages-and-accountable-handoffs). Immutable and identified by its content digest. A constraint set is typed on every boundary crossing, including the continuation and the founder-facing brief.

EffectIdentity.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#6-concurrency-failure-retry-and-stop). Allocated by C04 before release, never after it. The identity is the triple of effect class, counterparty and payload digest.

ExistenceJustification.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#4-temporary-workers-model-choice-and-bounded-reasoning). Exactly one admitted reason, with the unit that reason predicates on and a decidable test that can return false. Specialized knowledge is refused as a reason.

FieldAuthority.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#6-concurrency-failure-retry-and-stop). One authority per field path per epoch. C01 declares the authority and only the named authority writes the value; no last-writer-wins path exists anywhere.

GrantDeliveryReceipt.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#8-instructions-and-reusable-skills). Written once, by the enforcement point, at the first effect. It attests arrival and not scope.

InstrumentCalibration.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#9-positive-adverse-and-capacity-limited-conformance). Written by C06 or a dedicated instrument custodian excluded from every producing path. A calibration write is a protected change.

ProjectionGrant.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#11-consequence-class-and-the-layer-contract). Issued as a C2 act and released by C04. Scope and purpose are resolved from a ParameterAuthority, never asserted by the recipient.

ShedDecision.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#12-standing-accountability). Written once per shed. C02 proposes and C01 authorises; the record exists whether or not the holder concurred.

StandingHolder.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#12-standing-accountability). A holder exists for a duty class only where all three hold together: the duty's clock can run while no case is admitted, an outside party has a right to reach the company about it, and the duty survives closure of the work that created it.

StandingInterest.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#7-durable-schedules-and-capacity-gaps). No precondition may invoke a model. An interest arms only when every declared prerequisite holds simultaneously, unexpired, uncontradicted and at or above its required trust class.

UnmatchedPoolEntry.description: WORK-1.1 (05-work-agents-skills.md#7-durable-schedules-and-capacity-gaps). The pool is the computable complement of the armed set at a journal position, not a destination anything is swept into.
